name: B10-0064/2025 (PPE) – Situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on 10 January 2025
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Venezuela following the usurpation of the presidency on the 10th of January 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament says Nicolás Maduro stole the presidency on 10 January 2025 and has no right to rule. It backs Edmundo González Urrutia as the real election winner. It asks the European Union to punish Maduro and his allies harder, to press for the release of political prisoners, and to support Venezuela's democratic forces. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It calls for wider sanctions on Maduro and his circle.
- **Who it affects:** Maduro, his officials and families, and political prisoners in Venezuela.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and other bodies. They decide on any action.
